steps.message:
Implemented the source-side compatibility for `@babel/parser` 7.17.0.

Changes:
- Enabled Babel 7.17 parser plugins: `regexpUnicodeSets`, `destructuringPrivate`, `decoratorAutoAccessors`.
- Added support for new hack pipeline topic tokens `^^` and `@@`, preserving the original token when printing.
- Added `ClassAccessorProperty` handling across the JS printer/comment/parens/class-property paths.

Verification:
- `yarn prettier ... --check`
- `yarn jest tests/format/js/babel-plugins tests/format/js/pipeline-operator tests/format/js/regex tests/format/js/classes tests/format/js/class-comment tests/format/js/decorator-comments --runInBand`
- Manual Babel 7.17 syntax smoke for `/v` regex, auto accessors, private destructuring, and `^^`/`@@` pipeline topics.

No test files were modified.
